title: Generative Adversarial Nets
summary: Ian J. Goodfellow, Jean Pouget-Abadie, Mehdi Mirza, Bing Xu, David Warde-Farley, Sherjil Ozair, Aaron Courville, and Yoshua Bengio submitted the paper associated with arXiv:1406.2661 on June 10, 2014. The work proposes a framework for estimating generative models through an adversarial process in which a generative model and a discriminative model are trained together as a minimax two-player game.
significance: A documented research-publication milestone introducing the adversarial generative-model framework described in the paper and subsequently published in the 2014 NeurIPS proceedings.
